name: Plato
source: Ancient Aliens EP03 Atlantis kit (15 Nov 2026): DESIGNS.md section 8, task T6; the look target is panels 39, 47 and 48 of the Atlantis sheets
personality: Plato, the old potato philosopher who wrote Atlantis down. Heavy-lidded, calm, never speaks: he looks up from his scroll, winks, and puts a finger to his lips (proposal until Jonny has seen it).
notes: Costume type plato (engine/page/costumes-plato.js, its header is the usage text): ONE white hair mass round the back of the head from a high bald forehead (wave lobes, drawn curl strokes), ONE full beard with a broad moustache over it (the mouth is under the hair), a cream himation: a wrap with a rolled collar and a broad pleated band from under the right arm across the chest, over the left shoulder and down the back; draped sleeves over the upper arms, bare golden forearms, cream 3-finger gloves, brown sandals. Body 1.08 high x 0.80 wide x 0.70 deep, no sprout.
